perks.name: Proximity Grenades

perks.name: Demolitionist
perks.description: Kills with this weapon generate grenade energy. Activating your grenade ability reloads this weapon from reserves.

enhanced.name: Demolitionist
enhanced.description: Final blows with this weapon generate an improved amount of grenade energy. Activating your grenade ability reloads this weapon from reserves.

perks.name: Field Prep
perks.description: Increases ammo generation. Faster reload, stow, and ready speed when you're crouching.

enhanced.name: Field Prep
enhanced.description: Greatly increases ammo generation. Improves reload, stow, and ready speed when you're crouching.

perks.name: Threat Detector
perks.description: Increased reload, stability, and handling when enemies are in close proximity.

enhanced.name: Threat Detector
enhanced.description: Greatly increased reload, stability, and handling when targets are in close proximity.

perks.name: Heal Clip
perks.description: Reloading shortly after dealing a final blow grants Cure to you and your nearby allies.

enhanced.name: Heal Clip
enhanced.description: Reloading after dealing a final blow grants Cure to you and your nearby allies. You have additional time to perform the reload.

perks.name: Auto-Loading Holster
perks.description: The holstered weapon is automatically reloaded after a short period of time.

enhanced.name: Auto-Loading Holster
enhanced.description: The holstered weapon is automatically reloaded after an improved short period of time.

perks.name: Envious Assassin
perks.description: Defeating targets with other weapons before drawing this one transfers ammo to the magazine from reserves. This effect can overflow the magazine based on the number of targets defeated.

enhanced.name: Envious Assassin
enhanced.description: Defeating targets with other weapons before drawing this one transfers additional ammo to the magazine from reserves. This effect can overflow the magazine based on the number of targets defeated.

perks.name: Strategist
perks.description: Final blows with this weapon generate class ability energy. Activating your class ability briefly improves this weapon's stability.

enhanced.name: Strategist
enhanced.description: Final blows with this weapon generate improved class ability energy. Activating your class ability briefly improves this weapon's stability.

perks.name: Kill Clip
perks.description: Reloading after a kill grants increased damage.

enhanced.name: Kill Clip
enhanced.description: Reloading after defeating a target grants increased damage for an improved duration.

perks.name: Adrenaline Junkie
perks.description: This weapon gains increased damage and handling from final blows with grenades or this weapon.

enhanced.name: Adrenaline Junkie
enhanced.description: This weapon gains increased damage and handling from final blows with grenades or this weapon for an improved duration.

perks.name: Desperate Measures
perks.description: Weapon final blows grant bonus damage. Melee and grenade final blows grant a larger damage bonus that can stack.

enhanced.name: Desperate Measures
enhanced.description: Weapon final blows grant bonus damage for an improved duration. Melee and grenade final blows grant a larger damage bonus that can stack.

perks.name: Incandescent
perks.description:
Defeating a target spreads scorch to those nearby.
More powerful combatants and opposing Guardians cause scorch in a larger radius.

enhanced.name: Incandescent
enhanced.description:
Defeating a target spreads a longer lasting scorch to those nearby.
More powerful combatants and opposing Guardians cause scorch in a larger radius.

perks.name: Vorpal Weapon
perks.description: Increased damage against bosses, vehicles, and Guardians with their Super active.

enhanced.name: Vorpal Weapon
enhanced.description: Increased damage against bosses, vehicles, and Guardians with their Super active. Stability is improved. Swords have improved guard resistance.
